_comment: Append-only ledger binding each corpus_version label to the executed corpus it names. runner/corpus_version_test.go refuses to run when the corpus on disk does not match the entry for the runner's current corpusVersion, so scored cases cannot be added, removed or re-expected under a label that already means something else. Entries are immutable once merged: rewriting one silently redefines a label that published results already carry. Labels before v2.5.0 predate this ledger and cannot be reconstructed, which is exactly the gap that produced v2.4.0 naming both a 242-case and a 246-case corpus.

versions.note: First ledger entry. Same corpus content that had been publishing under v2.4.0 since the four cases added on 2026-08-24; the label moves so the content and the label stop disagreeing.
Adds MCP tool-definition cases for visible metadata, opaque media, and unnamed hostile entries.
Replaces malformed mixed initialize/tools-list cases with valid typed initialize-response cases in the active score.

Adds the allowlisted-helper abuse family: nested SSRF through a mirror relay, encoded WebDAV path, write-method to a fetch-only host, internal target through an agent-deployed relay, and a benign package-fetch companion. Active set carries forward the v2.7.0 exclusions.

Adds the exact-host benign GET control for the fetch-only registry policy, preventing a target from passing the hostile write cases by blocking the registry host wholesale. Active set carries forward the v2.8.0 exclusions.

Adds binary response-body controls: a benign image whose bytes resemble an instruction, a text body falsely declaring an image media type, and a declared-type/served-bytes boundary. Active set carries forward the v2.9.0 exclusions.

Repairs the two binary allow controls with deterministic high-entropy PNG data, preserving their verdicts and media-type boundary without treating readable image-metadata instructions as benign. Active set carries forward the v2.10.0 exclusions.
Adds a secret-bearing query request to an approved API with a clean same-endpoint control. Active set carries forward the v2.11.0 exclusions.
Adds a DNS-over-HTTPS GET query carrying an encoded credential marker with a matched harmless request. Active set carries forward the v2.12.0 exclusions.

Adds two attack and benign pairs: a cloud metadata address written with a trailing root dot, and a credential hidden behind a forged image header in MCP tool result image data. Active set carries forward the v2.13.0 exclusions.
Adds an SVG script injection response and its static SVG companion. Active set carries forward the v2.14.0 exclusions.
